Report the DE results from eSVD

Source: R/report_results.R
report_results.Rd

Report the DE results from eSVD

Usage

report_results(input_obj)

Arguments

input_obj

eSVD object output from compute_pvalue.

Value

a data frame with one row per gene (in the order of input_obj$teststat_vec) and columns genes, logFC (\(\log_2\) of the case-to-control ratio of posterior means), logFC_se (the standard error of logFC, also on the \(\log_2\) scale; see compute_log_fold_change for what it is a standard error of and how it compares with those of 'DESeq2', 'dreamlet' and 'NEBULA'), log10pvalue (\(-\log_{10}\) of the two-sided p-value), pvalue, pvalue_adj (Benjamini-Hochberg) and nuisance_status (a factor: what estimate_nuisance did with the gene's over-dispersion, one of estimated, capped, boundary, failed; NA for a gene that was not analyzed, and for every gene of an object built before version 1.2.0). The fold change and the statistic of a capped or boundary gene reflect the cap on its rate, and those of a failed gene the floor. pvalue underflows to 0 for any gene with log10pvalue above about 308, so genes should be ranked by log10pvalue, which keeps the distinction. logFC / logFC_se is not the statistic behind pvalue, which is computed on the linear scale and calibrated with an empirical null. logFC_se is NA, with a warning, for an object built before version 1.1.0, which does not store it.

Examples

set.seed(10)
sim <- generate_null(cell_per_person = 15, num_genes = 40,
                     num_individuals = 8)
esvd_obj <- initialize_esvd(dat = sim$obs_mat,
                            covariates = sim$covariates,
                            metadata_individual = sim$metadata_individual,
                            case_control_variable = "CC",
                            bool_intercept = TRUE,
                            k = 2,
                            lambda = 0.1)
esvd_obj <- reparameterization_esvd_covariates(input_obj = esvd_obj,
                                               fit_name = "fit_Init",
                                               omitted_variables = "Log_UMI")
esvd_obj <- opt_esvd(input_obj = esvd_obj,
                     max_iter = 5,
                     offset_variables = setdiff(colnames(esvd_obj$covariates), "CC"),
                     fit_name = "fit_First",
                     fit_previous = "fit_Init")
esvd_obj <- reparameterization_esvd_covariates(input_obj = esvd_obj,
                                               fit_name = "fit_First",
                                               omitted_variables = "Log_UMI")
esvd_obj <- estimate_nuisance(input_obj = esvd_obj)
esvd_obj <- compute_posterior(input_obj = esvd_obj,
                              alpha_max = 2 * max(sim$obs_mat))
esvd_obj <- compute_test_statistic(input_obj = esvd_obj)
esvd_obj <- compute_pvalue(input_obj = esvd_obj)
result_df <- report_results(esvd_obj)
utils::head(result_df[order(result_df$log10pvalue, decreasing = TRUE), ])
